title: Context receipt
why: See the exact decisions retrieved and saved by this session, with source and version.
risk: A retrieved memory does not prove the agent applied it.
concept: A slim strip below the terminal header says 2 retrieved · 1 saved. Open right drawer Context receipt lists exact returned records, memory_get full read vs memory_context index, author, version, branch, timestamp. Selected decision Use existing Geist fonts by Claude v3. Label Retrieved, never Used. Only source facts; mock receipt telemetry is proposed.

title: Recall in place
why: Find and prepare a decision for one agent without leaving the terminal grid.
risk: Wrong target pane or excessive context can undo the benefit.
concept: Open command palette Memories search font decision; results with project, author, scope, version; selected preview Use existing Geist fonts. Footer explicit target Codex pane 02 feat/sidebar and Prepare attachment, no send or automatic execution. Proposed insert into editable agent message. Reuse command palette not new shortcut system.

title: Decision beside the question
why: Answer a repeated question with the current decision and its reason.
risk: A similar question may require a different decision on this branch.
concept: Claude pane waiting asks Should I download another font? Small anchored card beside question Possible match: Reuse local Geist fonts, saved by Gero yesterday, v3, scope this repo, branch main. Read reason, Compare context, Prepare reply buttons. Say Possible match not automated correctness. Never auto answer or auto approve.

title: Branch brief
why: Read what teammates learned on this branch before taking the next step.
risk: Private notes must never enter a team brief by implication.
concept: Right drawer Branch brief feat/sidebar with existing Team thread, authors Claude and Codex, latest decisions chronologically, changed since your last visit separator, one open question. Explicit Team only filter. Open full thread button. It extends existing branch thread, not a new chat. No private promotion. One source link per note.

title: Memory health
why: Distinguish local memory, session bridge and cloud sync without visiting Settings.
risk: A green session bridge cannot certify memory reads or writes.
concept: Bottom workspace bar Memories local ready · 1 session needs checking; open small popover lists Local store ready, Claude bridge connected, Codex no session reported, Gemini disabled, Cloud offline last sync 12m ago. Neutral starting state, Inspect connection button, local reads continue. Do not equate bridge with writing. No generic green Memory working badge.

title: First real reuse
why: Show the first cross-agent retrieval of an actual project decision.
risk: Demo activity or a retrieval must not masquerade as verified application.
concept: Small nonblocking First retrieval card in workspace linking Claude saved Use local Geist fonts yesterday to Codex retrieved today, source record and session link. Text Same decision. Another session. Open receipt or Dismiss. Empty state awaiting a real retrieval rather than fake celebration. Show prototype populated sample. Existing welcome tour stays.

title: Result with evidence
why: Separate a quiet agent from a change that is ready for review.
risk: Test results become stale as soon as the checked files change.
concept: Right dock Review result for pane Codex: task Sidebar spacing, changed files 3, checks build passed at commit a13f92, tests not run, working tree changed after check warning, open diff and prepare handoff. Existing PR review and graph board remain. This is pre-PR evidence beside terminal, no success inferred from unread or process exit.

title: Shared worktree awareness
why: Expose two agents editing the same checkout before people overwrite each other.
risk: Being in the same checkout is only a risk signal, not proof of a file conflict.
concept: Compact workspace drawer Shared checkout: Claude pane01 and Codex pane02 same canonical worktree path; 2 active sessions, ownership not declared. Suggested scopes: header vs sidebar marked user-declared, no inferred authorship. Compare changed files and Edit task note. Another Gemini pane different worktree separate. Informational, no locks, no auto pause, no writes. This is risk visibility not merge conflict certainty.
